name: How do I choose the right contractor for whole-house window replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for whole-house window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for whole-house window replacement, look for companies with extensive experience, proper licensing, and insurance. Check their references and read reviews from previous clients. Ensure they offer a clear, detailed quote with no hidden fees and provide a strong warranty on both materials and labor. A good contractor should also communicate effectively, help you navigate material choices, and manage the permit process efficiently. City Dweller, LLC, for example, is a licensed general contractor serving the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience, proper licensing, and insurance. Check references, reviews, and ensure they offer clear quotes and warranties. Effective communication is also key.
